doc: I26 prereg instrument (the contract is the docstring of tests_m3/test_fact.py; BUILD_PLAN I26; whitepaper §5.5, Thm 6.8, Def 6.13, §8.4 FACT row, §8.5, §11.4 N3, App. D, App. E FACT row, App. F fact_z). Frozen at the I26 prereg; the build reads it and never edits it. sort_types: I30's model sidecar, whose documents, binding (the deployment that is Reach's initial state and the real side of every replay) and typed model the FACT section builds on. documents: the transitions documents FACT reads for M3, the extracted rollup document I20 adopted (docs/HUMAN_ANSWERS.md Q19: extracted facts are the input of every M3 law; no hand-written fact document and nothing computed from one is read). hypotheses: the hypotheses of spec/M2/lib/oracles.json that a FACT law can rest on, each with the roles rule H1 assigns from it (premise: a document constant the hypothesis identifies; functions: the external functions whose answers in a witness come from the binding's stand-in for the component; interpretation: the consumers whose meaning the hypothesis fixes) and its verdict, copied from the audit round M2/2 (audit/rounds/M2/round2/a4.json hypotheses.<id>.result and .finding, I21): Hyp-Z0-kzg passes (the computed KZG versioned hash of the all-zero blob equals ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH, Rollup.sol:25, and the Go EmptyVersionedHash); HypZ fails (F-M2-41: the zstd codec encodes the empty payload as nothing and decoding zeros fails; target finding T2: ParseBatch rejects the 8 mainnet commits that carry the zero blob, batches 1, 23, 25-28, 271, 310); Hyp-ISubmitter fails (F-M2-40: updateChallengeDeposit changes the deposit; a staked, unslashed submitter can be inactive); HypV-proof1 is untestable (no prover). search: the refutation budget (I30's stages and values, I27's continuation depth and candidate cap) and the time candidates (I31's rule). measure: the representative domain of rule F9. term_size: I30's measure (1), law_terms, and its budget, applied to product programs (BUILD_PLAN I26 risks). backtest: the frozen map of the back-test against M1 (rules FB1-FB4): the M1 FACT law, the analogue rule F4 gives for it, and the move of a kernel witness to the M1 model's inputs, which transcribes the binding's encodings (replay/M1/solidity/HolonTraceReplay.t.sol: who2addr(w) = 0x1000 + w for w >= 2 and the deploying test contract for w = 1, the Rollup's owner; a time is EPOCH + t, EPOCH 1700000000, the M1 initial clock t = 10; blobEnc(1) = ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH and blobEnc(v) = (1 << 248) | v; a header's parent is named by its index) and the M1 stand-in agg of keccak256 over the blob versioned hashes (spec/M2/lib/oracles.json agg: AGG_BASE + b_enc, AGG_BASE 1000; gen/M1/model/morph_rollup.bend d_blob_hash at version 2).

Hyp-ISubmitter.meaning: isActive(a) holds exactly for the staked, unslashed submitters; challengeDeposit() = DEP; a lost challenge slashes, and so deactivates, the batch's submitter: what makes the slash call's argument the party whose bond is at risk

Hyp-Z0-kzg.meaning: the document constant ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH is the KZG versioned hash of the all-zero blob, 0x01 || sha256(0xc0 || 0^47)[1:] (the value recorded here, computed by holon/oracles/zero_blob.py, results/M2/hypotheses.json): a blob-hash list [ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH] delivers the zero blob

HypV-proof1.meaning: the binding's verifier stand-in accepts a proof iff its first byte is 0x01: a rule of the stand-in, not a property of the real verifier

HypZ.meaning: Dec(Enc x ++ 0^k) = x: what derivation makes of the delivered blobs, so that a difference of delivered blob lists is a difference of derived batches

search.time_candidates: E - 1, E and E + 1 for every term E an atom of a check of the candidate step compares with block.timestamp, evaluated on the candidate state, and the trace's own times (never 0, never decreasing)

move.blob_rule: a blob versioned hash (1 << 248) | v that is not in blob_tokens moves to the token v (blobEnc's inverse)
move.act: M.A_<action>{who, ver, parent, n, lbn, prev, post, blobs}: who the caller's token, ver the input's version, parent the parent header's index (bytes 1..8), n numL1Messages, lbn lastBlockNumber, prev and post the state roots as numbers, blobs the step's blob tokens; withdrawalRoot and the parent header's other bytes are not M1 inputs
move.wait: a step whose block.timestamp minus clock_offset exceeds the M1 clock is preceded by M.A_wait{dt} of the difference, which joins the shared prefix p

cf_bridge.definition: gen/M1/model/morph_rollup.bend d_blob_hash(2n, xs) = 1000 + b_enc(xs), b_enc(Nil) = 0, b_enc(Con{h, t}) = 1 + b_pair(h, b_enc(t)), b_pair(a, b) = (a + b)(a + b + 1)/2 + b
